title: Replace Stratified K-Fold with Group K-Fold for Cross-Validation
description: Request to formally update FR-003 in the specification to allow Group K-Fold cross-validation instead of Stratified K-Fold.
rationale: Stratified K-Fold based on density values fails to prevent data leakage in metallic glass datasets where multiple samples share similar base compositions. Group K-Fold, grouping by the dominant element, ensures that the model is evaluated on truly novel chemical systems, providing a more rigorous and realistic assessment of generalization performance.

impact_assessment.metrics_impact: Reported R² and MAE may decrease as the model can no longer rely on memorizing composition families. This is a desired outcome for scientific validity.
impact_assessment.implementation_effort: Low. Requires switching from `StratifiedKFold` to `GroupKFold` in `code/models/train.py` and adding a step to derive the `dominant_element` group variable.
impact_assessment.risk_level: Low. This change improves the scientific rigor of the validation process.

proposed_spec_text: FR-003: The model validation shall use Group K-Fold cross-validation (k=5) where groups are defined by the dominant element of the composition. This ensures that all samples of a specific chemical system are kept together in either the training or test set to prevent data leakage.
